title: False Payment Success Screen
business_scenario: Customer returns from an external simulated gateway redirect or navigates directly to the callback URL with status parameters.
symptoms: Frontend displays 'Payment Successful! Order Confirmed' even when the backend order is still PENDING_PAYMENT or FAILED.
reproduction_steps: Identify an order in PENDING_PAYMENT state (e.g. ord-2026-0004).
Navigate to the payment callback or call the verification flow with query string status=success.
Observe frontend displaying success without contacting the backend verification API.
expected_behavior: Frontend must call /api/payments/verify/:orderId and render success ONLY if the backend confirms the payment was actually settled as SUCCESS.
actual_behavior: Frontend trusts client-side redirect parameters without verifying the payment state against the backend truth.
root_cause: The payment callback view reads status=success from the redirect state rather than making an authorized backend verification request to /api/payments/verify/:orderId.
acceptance_criteria: The payment verification endpoint must return verified: false for unpaid orders, and client must not confirm orders without server verification.
reference_fix: Always query GET /api/payments/verify/:orderId on payment callback and strictly gate success rendering on verified === true.
regression_tests: Legitimately settled order returns verified: true.
